name: gbif-biodiversity-mcp-server
description: Search GBIF species taxonomy, occurrence records, datasets, and publishers via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

gbif_user_agent.title: GBIF User-Agent
gbif_user_agent.description: Sent as the User-Agent header on every GBIF API request. GBIF asks integrators to identify themselves with a contact URL or email so it can get in touch about problem traffic. Leave blank to send the server name, version, and repository URL.
